name: Opening hours
description: Opening hours with a live status: a big "Open now, closes at 17:00" or "Closed, opens tomorrow at 09:00", this week's hours with today highlighted, split hours and lunch breaks, and holiday closures that override the week. For shops, pharmacies, libraries, clinics and offices. Type special dates in, or keep them in a Google Sheet.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: subtitle
params.label: Subtitle
params.default: 12 Harbour Street · Prescriptions and walk-in advice
params.help: One line under the name, such as the address. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer line
params.default: Out of hours? Call 0161 496 0000 or visit northwind.example/urgent
params.help: Small print along the bottom. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: Shown beside the name. The default is a placeholder; replace it or clear it.

params.name: hours_mon
params.label: Monday
params.help: Times like 09:00-17:00. Split hours with a comma: 09:00-12:30, 13:30-17:00. Closed, or 24h. 18:00-02:00 runs past midnight.

params.name: specials
params.label: Special dates
params.help: One per line: Date | Hours | Note. Date is 2026-12-24, a range 2026-12-24..2026-12-26, or 12-25 for every year. These override the week.
params.default:
12-24 | 08:30-13:00 | Christmas Eve
12-25..12-26 | Closed | Christmas
12-31 | 08:30-15:00 | New Year's Eve
01-01 | Closed | New Year's Day
2026-10-09 | 08:30-13:00 | Staff training in the afternoon
2026-11-02 | 10:00-13:00, 14:00-18:30 | Opening late for stocktake

params.name: specials_source
params.label: Special dates data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet, CSV or Manual table with Date, Hours and Note columns. When connected it replaces the special dates typed above.

params.name: date_col
params.label: Date column
params.help: The heading of that column in your source, in Latin letters.

params.name: specials_count
params.label: Upcoming special dates to list
params.help: 0 hides the list. This week's table always shows special hours on the day they apply.

params.name: open_label
params.label: Status: open
params.help: Leave empty for "Open now" in the screen's language.

params.name: soon_label
params.label: Status: closing soon
params.help: Leave empty for "Closing soon" in the screen's language.

params.name: closed_label
params.label: Status and table: closed
params.help: Leave empty for "Closed" in the screen's language.

params.name: always_open_label
params.label: Open around the clock
params.help: Leave empty for "Open 24 hours" in the screen's language.

params.name: closes_text
params.label: Closing line
params.help: {time} is the closing time. Leave empty for "Closes at {time}" in the screen's language; type - to hide it.

params.name: reopens_text
params.label: Break line
params.help: Shown when it opens again later the same day. Leave empty for the screen's language; type - to hide it.

params.name: opens_text
params.label: Opening line
params.help: {day} is today, tomorrow or a weekday; {time} the opening time. Leave empty for the screen's language; - hides it.

params.name: hours_heading
params.label: Heading: this week
params.help: Leave empty for "Opening hours" in the screen's language; type - to hide the heading.

params.name: specials_heading
params.label: Heading: special dates
params.help: Leave empty for "Special opening times" in the screen's language; type - to hide the heading.

params.name: today_label
params.label: Today marker
params.help: Leave empty for the word for today in the screen's language.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone of the business
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The words, days, dates and times on screen, for example en-GB, fr-FR or de-DE. Leave empty for the screen's language.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: Today's row, headings and special dates.

params.name: soon_minutes
params.label: Closing soon, minutes before closing
params.help: 0 turns the closing-soon state off.
